name: St Mary the Virgin and All Saints Church

layers.essential_history: [[c:The church stands beside the Prebendal Manor, at the heart of the old village.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Cnut's court included Aethelric, Bishop of Dorchester-on-Thames, who later bought the nearby village of Elton.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Brother Aldred is praying. He saw Ulf the guard slip out of the hall with something hidden in his cloak.]]

evidence: [[c:Brother Aldred saw Ulf leave the hall with something under his cloak.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 50 metres as the crow flies, to the Prebendal Manor.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
